numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Trust-region solver (trust-exact) constructs a subproblem, including Hessian evaluation, at every proposed point before deciding acceptance; when fun returns nan at a trial point the acceptance comparisons evaluate to False, the trust radius does not change, and the algorithm makes no progress until the iteration limit is reached; steps outside the Hessian's numerical domain can raise an error.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Only the objective is evaluated at the proposed point to compute actual reduction (actual_reduction = m.fun - fun(x_proposed)); the subproblem is created only after the step is accepted; a NaN trial objective is treated as +inf so the step is rejected and the trust radius shrinks.
trigger_conditions: a proposed trial point lies outside the function's numerical domain so fun returns nan or inf
the fun value at the trial point is nan, making the acceptance comparisons False
Hessian evaluated at an out-of-domain rejected trial point (e.g. x<=0 in the regression test) raises ValueError in the original code path

oracle_clues: issue #12503 describes the algorithm running without progress until the iteration limit when fun returns nan
the fix replaces actual_reduction = m.fun - m_proposed.fun with actual_reduction = m.fun - fun(x_proposed) and maps NaN proposed values to np.inf
regression test test_trust_exact_rejects_nan_trial_point asserts success and x close to [1] with atol 1e-8
the issue reports scipy 1.4.1 and numpy 1.18.1; the passages do not state the exact version for the fix

category_specific_evidence: Trust-region solver (trust-exact) constructs a subproblem at every proposed point before deciding acceptance, which evaluates the Hessian even for rejected steps (PR#26044, issue #12503).
Fix evaluates only the objective fun(x_proposed) to compute actual_reduction and creates the subproblem only after the step is accepted (rho > eta).
NaN objective values at trial points are treated as +inf so the step is rejected and the trust radius shrinks; without this, NaN comparisons evaluate False and the algorithm fails to progress.
Regression test test_trust_exact_rejects_nan_trial_point uses initial_trust_radius 10, maxiter 10, tol 1e-8, start x0=[2.1], and asserts success and x close to [1] with atol 1e-8.
Failure mode described in issue: with fun returning nan the algorithm may run without progress until the iteration limit is reached, or raise an error from a Hessian evaluated outside the domain.
reproduction_risks: Hessian evaluated at out-of-domain point (x<=0 in the test) raises ValueError in the original code path, so the reproduction depends on hess being called at rejected trial points.
Issue reports scipy 1.4.1 and numpy 1.18.1 as the version where the bug was observed; the passages do not state the exact version for the fix.
